prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop product UI concept for Alloc, 1500 × 1050 pixels, queue-first composition option B
Primary request: Design one polished operational finance desktop dashboard for Alloc's approved “Quiet Operator” redesign. Linear-inspired quality and density, but clearly original and not a copy. The queue is the starting point: a compact list of purchase requests and pending reviews on the left of the work surface; the selected “Buffalo Beacon pilot trip” opens in a wide central detail pane; a narrow right inspector shows authority and provenance. Financial state is visually dominant, not an AI assistant.
Scene/backdrop: flat warm crisp gray application canvas. Full-screen native desktop web app, no browser chrome. Muted charcoal left navigation rail, compact predictable top header bars, restrained 1px hairline borders.
Composition/framing: exact 1500 × 1050 landscape screenshot. Dense three-column working area after the persistent sidebar: queue 310px, request detail flexible and wide, authority/provenance inspector 260px. The main work surface should occupy most of the screen. Clear selection state, aligned rows, excellent visual hierarchy, practical whitespace, minimal radius, almost no shadow.
Style/medium: photoreal-sharp high-fidelity UI mockup; modern enterprise operations software; humanist sans throughout; tabular numerals for all money; small crisp labels; calm and trustworthy.
Color palette: warm off-white and crisp light gray canvas, muted charcoal sidebar, graphite text, quiet sage/blue-gray status accents, one restrained amber warning accent, high contrast.
Text (verbatim): “Alloc”; “Northstar Fieldworks”; “Requests”; “Overview”; “Memory”; “Forecast”; “Activity”; “Synthetic mock data”; “As of Sep 12, 2026”; “Request queue”; “3 open · 1 needs review”; “Needs review”; “Buffalo Beacon pilot trip”; “Maya Chen”; “$240.00 USD”; “Revision 3”; “Refrigeration maintenance visit”; “Line maintenance freight revision”; “Request detail”; “Cumulative amendment limit exceeded”; “Revised total”; “$240.00 USD”; “Current commitment”; “$210.00 USD”; “Cumulative change”; “+$60.00 USD”; “Submitted”; “Sep 12, 2026 · 2:02 PM”; “Forecast impact”; “Projected through Sep 30, 2026”; “$240.00 USD”; “Actual spend”; “$120.00 USD”; “Outstanding commitment”; “$180.00 USD”; “Scenario adjustment”; “−$60.00 USD”; “Authority & provenance”; “Human approval required”; “No model execution authority”; “Authoritative”; “source_mock_simulator”; “request_buffalo_trip-amendment-3”; “Source revision 1”; “scope view — not additive”; “Evidence informs context. It does not grant spending authority.”; “Approve revision 3”; “Decline”; “This is synthetic, mock-backed data. Not real financial data.”
Layout details: charcoal sidebar contains compact Alloc wordmark, navigation items, organization switcher and local-status footer. Header over work surface shows Requests title, company, synthetic label, as-of date, search and compact controls. Queue rows use restrained status pills, request title, requester, revision, and right-aligned exact amount. Central pane includes a quiet amber review banner; a disciplined two-column key-value summary; a compact forecast impact section using simple horizontal contribution bars and exact supporting rows; and a bounded scope strip labeled exactly “scope view — not additive”. Bottom action bar has a dark primary “Approve revision 3” button and low-emphasis “Decline”. Right inspector presents authority status first, then source identifiers, timestamps and a compact evidence note. Use icons sparingly.
Constraints: exact totals must remain legible and consistent; show USD explicitly; keep synthetic/mock labeling always visible; all information in aligned rows, not decorative cards; selected Buffalo request is unmistakable; authority and provenance are adjacent to the decision; interface must look implementable in React/CSS; no brand copying or Linear logo; no people or photography; no watermark.
Avoid: field-ledger paper, punched holes, handwriting, serif finance display, paper sheets, texture, gradients, glassmorphism, neon, decorative card grid, oversized hero typography, giant empty areas, glossy effects, noisy charts, chatbot-first layout, colorful consumer-fintech styling.
